whoFor: Owners and leadership teams deciding where to take the business next, or why results are not where they should be.

benefits.title: Decisions based on evidence
benefits.text: Your options are compared using your own figures and market facts.

benefits.title: A plan people can follow
benefits.text: Goals, owners and measures written down in plain language.

benefits.title: A neutral view
benefits.text: An outside reviewer who has no stake in any one option.

whatYouReceive: A diagnosis of where the business stands
A written strategy or business model review with clear options
A prioritised action plan with owners and measures
A presentation of findings to your leadership team
whatYouProvide: Your current plans, figures and organisation chart
Time with the owners and key managers
Honest answers about what is and is not working
doesNotInclude: Running the business or making decisions on your behalf
A promise of revenue, profit or growth results
